subject: Dangerous Drivers
comment: Council Comments Good Evening Council Members, I'm reaching out to pass along a growing concern in our neighborhood surrounding the dangerous intersection at 1700 S 700 E. The Mayor's office and would have cut if you but I had to contact them through some online form on their website. I know this falls into pretty administrative territory, but I wanted to at least get it on the record for potential future reference, particularly given what happened in January 2021. Tonight there was a fatal crash involving the death of a motorcycle rider and a matter of cars. We've seen multiple accidents and near-accidents when cars tried turning left from 700 E onto 1700 S. The intersection is a hill to a certain extent, and from the perspective of a vehicle that was hit (? think she was ok), she seemed at when they got in her to the ambulance). I have personally stopped turning left at that intersection on my way home from work, even though this extends my drive, because of the safety risk. My guess is that there is issue with the lane configuration in addition to speed. Even in our back it is gone hard to see cars coming the opposition direction when going left either way. The speed limit there is 35mph but I would estimate that the average speed is closer to 40-50-700 E at all hours of the day makes this even more of a concern. I only know what happened years in the intersection because the 17 year old girl tried their come up to be crying that she may have killed someone, and once the police and paramedics left, she knocked on my driver. She said she younger children from the apartments next door had been there at the corner and saw everything. I know that a solution isn't simple because this situation involves changes to traffic flow configuration, consideration of both speed limits, and consideration for some mitigation strategies or improvements. I also know that data is important in driving these decisions, and I would have to think based on everything what was the. I don't know what else he has been documented at this intersection, or how I can door-t strongly encourage the city to take this issue with the states Trade who might contact them if it could be helpful. If there is anything I can do to be of help please let me know. I hope you have a lovely evening, and that things are looking. Thank you for your taking your slime to recover. Sincerely, Libby Stockstill
